summary: Baldwin County deputies booked a man on aggravated assault and eluding charges, and Gulf Shores police booked a man on a first-degree elder financial-exploitation charge, the jail roster shows. No new bookings had posted for Thanksgiving morning when the roster was read; no new federal, state or district attorney releases.

entries.title: Aggravated assault and eluding arrest: John Paul Rush
body: John Paul Rush, 37, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 1:38 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.

He was booked on charges of aggravated assault involving a weapon other than a firearm or knife, against someone outside the family — an assault causing or threatening serious injury; third-degree assault; and attempting to elude police. He was in custody when the roster was read early Thursday.

entries.title: Elder financial exploitation arrest, Gulf Shores: Romario Rickardo Campbell
body: Gulf Shores police arrested Romario Rickardo Campbell, 32, at 10:57 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, according to the jail roster. No police statement or news report was found.

He was booked on a charge the roster lists as first-degree financial exploitation of the elderly — using an older person's money or property by deception or abuse of trust. The roster shows him released.

entries.title: Retail theft arrest: Felix Todderick Thompson
body: Felix Todderick Thompson, 40, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 2 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement was found.

He was booked on a first-degree retail theft charge — shoplifting at the highest value grade — along with a driving-while-revoked writ and three traffic failure-to-appear warrants. He was in custody when the roster was read early Thursday.

entries.title: Sex-offender registration arrest: Jeremy Rodney Hamill
body: Jeremy Rodney Hamill, 46, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 2:29 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, and booked early Wednesday, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on a charge of failing to register as a sex offender — not keeping required registration current — and on an alias writ for child support. He was in custody when the roster was read early Thursday.

entries.title: Murder charge, body found near Perdido: Arthur Lee Smoots Jr.
body: Atmore police said Wednesday, Nov. 25, that they charged Arthur Lee Smoots Jr. of Atmore with murder after a woman he had reported missing Tuesday was found dead in a concealed location near the Perdido community in Baldwin County. Police said she appeared to have died from at least one gunshot wound, according to the department's release as reported by FOX10 and 1819 News. Police had cited suspicious circumstances when they issued a missing-person alert.

Smoots is also charged with being a certain person forbidden to possess a firearm — having a gun while barred from owning one, such as after a felony conviction. 1819 News reported he was booked into the Escambia County jail with no bond. Police have not said where the shooting took place, and no Baldwin County agency has issued a statement.

entries.title: Federal fraud case, Fairhope gold-bar scam: Pradeep Patel, Saurav Sharma
body: Two men who collected gold bars from a Fairhope couple in a phone scam have admitted or moved to admit federal fraud charges, the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of Alabama said Tuesday, Nov. 24. Prosecutors said the couple was told in August 2025 that their bank account had been hacked and was persuaded to turn savings into Bitcoin and gold bars, losing about $295,000.

According to the release, Pradeep Patel picked up gold bars at the couple's Fairhope home in late August 2025, and Saurav Sharma collected the rest outside a store in Daphne in early September 2025. Both were indicted Jan. 28, 2026. Patel pleaded guilty Aug. 19 to conspiracy to commit mail fraud and admitted losses of $1.5 million to $3.5 million across several states; Sharma filed notice Nov. 23 that he intends to plead guilty to the same charge. Both remain in custody awaiting sentencing, prosecutors said. The FBI investigated.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 24–25: Laney Rachelle Dawson, Shawn Derek Wilson, Cody Nicholas Davis and others
body: Sheriff's deputies booked four people on family-related charges: Laney Rachelle Dawson, 31, arrested at 1:36 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, on a third-degree domestic violence charge; Rebecca Lynn Nettles, 49, arrested at 9:55 p.m. Tuesday on a simple assault charge involving a family member; Makenna Rae Odell, 28, arrested at 10:08 p.m. Tuesday on a harassment charge involving a family member; and Shawn Derek Wilson, 39, arrested at 1 p.m. Wednesday on a charge of violating a domestic violence protection order. The roster shows all four released.

Gulf Shores police arrested Cody Nicholas Davis, 36, at 12:33 a.m. Wednesday on methamphetamine possession and drug paraphernalia charges, and booked Jean Carlos Betancourt-Jimenez, 24, arrested Nov. 23, on dangerous-drug, paraphernalia and second-degree marijuana possession charges. Foley police arrested Michael L Delbrugge, 48, Tuesday evening on a dangerous-drug possession charge; he was released. Fairhope police arrested Shawn Michael Cobb, 48, at 7:17 a.m. Wednesday on a failure-to-appear warrant; Fairhope's own log lists a drug-paraphernalia charge. Deputies also booked Rocky Joseph Robinson, 42, on two probation violations, Lora Denise Henderson, 62, on an alias writ, and Kadyn David Stevens, 21, on a disorderly conduct charge with an arrest date of Nov. 16. All information is from the jail roster and the Fairhope police log.

entries.title: Domestic violence and resisting arrest: Alexander James Cordell
body: Alexander James Cordell, 24, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office on Tuesday, Nov. 24, according to the jail roster, which gives no arrest time. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.

He was booked on two counts of third-degree domestic violence — an assault, harassment or similar offence against a family or household member — and on charges of criminal mischief for damage to business property, resisting arrest and criminal trespass. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Auto theft arrest: Phillip Adam Fisher
body: Phillip Adam Fisher, 43, was arrested by the Baldwin County Sheriff's Office at 6:54 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, according to the jail roster. No sheriff's office statement or news report was found.
He was booked on an auto theft charge — taking a motor vehicle. He was in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday.

entries.title: Fleeing-police arrests, overnight Nov. 25: Kevin Eugene Willis, Isaiah Grace
body: Deputies arrested Kevin Eugene Willis, 34, at 12:51 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, on charges of attempting to elude a law enforcement officer — failing to stop for police — and public intoxication, according to the jail roster. Loxley police arrested Isaiah Grace, 60, at 2:25 a.m. on charges of attempting to elude police and harassment involving a family member.
Both were in custody when the roster was read early Wednesday. No police statements or news reports were found.

entries.title: Other arrests Nov. 24: Caleb Vaughn Gamble, Martel Nicholas Baten, Derrick Cordarrus Terrell and others
body: Daphne police arrested Caleb Vaughn Gamble, 20, at 12:50 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, on charges of sale of stolen property, possession of dangerous drugs, second-degree marijuana possession and drug paraphernalia; the roster shows him released the same day. The sheriff's office arrested Martel Nicholas Baten, 43, at 12:43 p.m. on charges of second-degree marijuana possession, tampering with physical evidence — destroying or hiding evidence — and possession of imitation drugs; he was also released Nov. 24. Deputies arrested Anthony Joseph Bradley, 28, at 9 a.m. on a harassment charge involving a family member.

Bay Minette police arrested Freddie Demetrius James, 42, at 11:10 a.m. on charges of public intoxication and drug paraphernalia, and Derrick Cordarrus Terrell, 40, at 2:50 p.m. on four failure-to-appear warrants. The state Bureau of Pardons and Paroles booked Michael Edward Paulini, 48, on a parole violation. Tuesday evening, deputies arrested Richard Lee Garner, 45, on a failure-to-appear warrant, and Jacob Andrew Coleman, 19, on a drug-paraphernalia charge; Coleman was released the same night. All information is from the jail roster.

entries.title: Civil judgments, elder exploitation case: John McNider, Angel McNider
body: John and Angel McNider, owners of Southern Justice Marine and Sales, who were indicted on a combined eight counts of financial exploitation of the elderly, also face civil judgments in at least three states, FOX10 reported Tuesday, citing court records.

FOX10 reported that a lender won a default judgment of $63,754 against the business in Washington County, New York, in September; that a Florida judge in Pinellas County ordered John McNider in May to pay $368,000 plus interest to a lumber and docking supplier; and that two people named as alleged victims in the criminal indictment have won civil judgments against the couple in Baldwin County. The McNiders' attorneys did not respond to the station, and the District Attorney's office did not answer questions about the allegations, FOX10 reported. Their arraignment is set for Jan. 20.
